coarse8.native_gradient_scope: Two entire public Encoding/Network buffers; no flat-offset partitions

predeclared_gate.comparator: Only this fresh split-native full12 versus fixedcoarse8 pair, each at its own u-only-selected checkpoint; coarse8 is the candidate and full12 the control
predeclared_gate.P1_definition: Known validation15 case-mean all-original-node incident-volume-averaged cornerP1 symmetric-Frobenius relativeL2, squared shear weight2; not optimization cell squared loss or solver GT strain.
predeclared_gate.P1_zero_tensor_baseline: RelativeL2=1 for the zero tensor on nonzero reference cases, independent of bandwidth_mode; there is no zero-input training branch.
predeclared_gate.if_pass: Same matched pair seed2027 replication, subject to root selection/freeze; no retrospective threshold tuning.
predeclared_gate.if_fail: Root selects one bounded task from the actual train/validation/representation evidence; no automatic second seed, extra mask group or cutoff/loss/radius/width sweep.

selection: Each own checkpoint uses known-load validation15 full-node physical signed-u vector mean only; P1 is measured at the same checkpoint

metric_units.u_relative_l2: dimensionless vector error in physical mm
metric_units.P1_relative_l2: dimensionless incident-volume-averaged cornerP1 symmetric Frobenius tensor error; squared shear weight2

zero_strain_baseline_definition: RelativeL2=1 for the zero tensor on nonzero reference cases, independent of bandwidth_mode; there is no zero-input training branch.
effective_capacity_limit: coarse8 reduces effective usable spatial representation and trainable gradient paths, despite equal stored parameter count. Utility gain cannot identify frequency causality independently of capacity/optimization
scientific_limits: Single paired seed2026 on reused known-load development validation; no final-test or significance claim.
P1 is u-derived corner FE proxy,not solver strain GT or sampled cell squared loss.
Fixed coarse8 is a bandwidth/capacity/optimization utility ablation,not proof of high-frequency Hash causality.
The motivating field diagnostic is one selected worst-TRAIN representative; no population attribution.
Both new split models are fresh controls; old fused or gate models are contextual only.
No cutoff,learning-rate,lambda,width,radius sweep or additional geometry features.
Only the two fresh split-native models are matched; historical fused or learned-gate models are contextual only.
Equal stored trainable parameters do not imply equal usable capacity. The fixed post-encoding mask also changes gradient paths and optimization; it is not an encoding speedup.
Natural initial predictions may differ. Mode-specific nonlearned mask buffers are not claimed equal.
Activation-gradient masking is measured on the public encoded output, without guessing Hash parameter partitions.
